facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports Senegal's regulator ARTP signed a roaming memorandum of understanding with its Benin counterpart on 11 December 2025, effective 1 March 2026.
Ecofin Agency reports free roaming took effect between Ghana and Benin in October 2024, and Togo and Benin have implemented their bilateral agreement.
Ecofin Agency reports Senegal's regulator ARTP signed a roaming memorandum of understanding with its Gambian counterpart on 11 December 2025, effective 1 March 2026.

GMB.note: The agreement is not yet in effect; it starts 1 March 2026.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports Senegal's regulator ARTP signed a roaming memorandum of understanding with its Malian counterpart on 11 December 2025, effective 1 March 2026.

MLI.note: The agreement is not yet in effect; it starts 1 March 2026.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports Senegal's regulator ARTP signed roaming memorandums of understanding with its counterparts in Benin, Gambia, Mali and Togo on 11 December 2025.

systems.system: ARTP roaming MoUs with Benin, Gambia, Mali, Togo

SEN.note: The agreements start 1 March 2026 and are not yet in effect.
